topic: Mastering the Change of Basis in Linear Algebra

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Perspective Shift
lecture_lines: A basis defines your coordinate grid.
animations: Fade in a standard Cartesian grid, color #FFFFFF. Color lecture line 1.
Highlight a vector v in blue color #3498DB. Color lecture line 2.
Transform the grid non-linearly to show new basis vectors. Color lecture line 3.

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Basis and Linear Combinations
lecture_lines: Any vector is a linear combination.
Summing basis vectors reaches any point.
Coordinates are weights of the basis.
animations: Display basis vectors i_hat and j_hat in #F1C40F. Color lecture line 1. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Show a vector v as a linear combination of basis. Color lecture line 2.
Color the coefficients of v in #2ECC71. Color lecture line 3.

sections.title: The Change of Basis Matrix (P)
lecture_lines: We need a transition matrix P.
P maps old to new basis.
Represent coordinates in a new grid.
P columns are the old basis.
Formula: v_old equals P times v_new.
animations: Display matrix P with elements in #FFFFFF over a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg]. Color lecture line 1.
Show matrix-vector multiplication P*v, color #9B59B6. Color lecture line 2.
Highlight the columns of P representing new basis. Color lecture line 3.
Show the output vector v' in new coordinates. Color lecture line 4.
Flash the final equation P*v = v' over a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg]. Color lecture line 5.

sections.title: Step-by-Step Computational Workflow
lecture_lines: Step one, identify the new basis.
Step two, construct the matrix P.
Step three, multiply by your coordinates.
animations: Display step 1: Identify original coordinates, color #FFFFFF. Color lecture line 1. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/notebook.svg]
Display step 2: Construct matrix P, color #E67E22. Color lecture line 2.
Display step 3: Multiply, showing product P*v in #27AE60. Color lecture line 3. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg]
